summary.tagline: Junkerdal National Park (Norwegian: Junkerdal nasjonalpark) is a national park in Saltdal Municipality and Fau

days.title: Northern Lakes and Highlands
days.start: Suggested: 9 AM start, after checking official access hours

stops.name: Balvatnet
stops.detail: On the plateau in the north of the park there are numerous lakes, the largest of which is Balvatnet.

stops.name: zentrale Bergmassiv
stops.detail: In the middle of the park, surrounding Balvatnet, lies the central mountain massif.

stops.name: Sulitjelma
stops.detail: The national park lies between the Junkerdal valley in the south and the village of Sulitjelma in the north.
